services.title: Foundations (intake + assessment)
services.blurb: Initial 90-minute physical assessment — movement screening, strength baseline, recovery capacity, and goal alignment. Mandatory before joining any cohort. We do not sell memberships before we know if you are a fit and we are honest if you are not.

services.title: The Cohort (12-week strength block)
services.blurb: 12-week structured strength block in 12-member groups, three sessions per week with the same coach. Built around squat, hinge, push, pull, and carry patterns with linear and conjugate periodization. The cohort is the product — coached small-group training is more effective than 1:1 for most lifters and a fraction of the cost.

services.title: 1:1 Coaching
services.blurb: One-on-one strength and athletic-development programming for working professionals, returning lifters, and athletes preparing for specific events. Three sessions per week minimum. Programming is individualized — not a generic template with your name on it.

services.title: Hypertrophy Lab
services.blurb: Bodybuilding-style strength and physique programming in a small-group setting. Different than the strength cohort — focused on muscle development and aesthetic outcomes through high-volume, controlled-tempo work. For lifters who already have strength and want to add tissue.

services.title: Recovery Suite (sauna + cold)
services.blurb: Cedar sauna at 195°F, cold plunge at 38°F, infrared therapy, percussion therapy, and contrast bathing protocols. Available to members on session days and stand-alone reservations otherwise. Recovery is part of the program — not a luxury.

services.title: Athlete Programming
services.blurb: Sport-specific programming for film/TV actors preparing for physical roles, professional athletes in offseason, and high-school and collegiate athletes home for summer. Confidentiality protocols for industry clients are standard practice.

process.title: Free intake
process.blurb: Free 60-minute movement screen and goal conversation. We assess fit honestly — including whether the membership makes sense for you right now.

process.title: Foundations
process.blurb: First two weeks of programming run as Foundations — coaching pattern execution before adding load. Skipped only if you have a documented training history we can verify.

process.title: Cohort assignment
process.blurb: Placed into a 12-member cohort matched to your schedule, training age, and goals. Same coach throughout the 12-week block. Same training partners.

process.title: 12-week reassessment
process.blurb: End-of-block testing on key strength markers, body composition, and movement quality. Programming shifts based on what the data shows — not on what we sold you to start.

faqs.q: Do I need experience to start?
faqs.a: No. Foundations is built for novice lifters and the cohort structure works for any training age. We program around what you can currently do and progress on a 12-week structure that scales with you. The most common starting point is no barbell experience.

Twelve members per cohort, three sessions per week (Mon-Wed-Fri or Tue-Thu-Sat), same coach and training partners across the 12-week block. Cohorts are matched on schedule, training age, and goals — we do not mix novice and advanced lifters in the same cohort.

Three coached sessions per week, programming, recovery suite access, video form review, and quarterly reassessment. Nutrition coaching is a separate add-on — we do not bundle it because not every member needs it.
Validated parking in the rear lot for member sessions. Street parking on Sunset is also available. Most members within a half-mile walk simply walk.
Limited drop-ins for members of partner gyms in other cities (one drop-in per visit, $85). We do not offer drop-ins as a default — the cohort dynamic depends on consistent attendance and chemistry.

faqs.q: How is this different from Equinox?
faqs.a: Equinox is a fitness facility. We are a coaching practice. Equinox sells you a membership and equipment access; we sell you 12-week structured progress under specific coaches. Different category of product. Many of our members keep their Equinox membership for cardio convenience.
1:12 in cohort sessions. 1:1 in private coaching. Coaches do not run the front desk, work the floor, or do administrative tasks — they coach. The math of attention is the model.
Up to 8 weeks per year for documented travel or medical reasons. Beyond that, we ask members to cancel and re-enroll when ready — the cohort dynamic depends on continuity.
